title: Temporal Self-Distillation: Faster Inference in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) promise fast inference by generating multiple tokens in parallel, but suffer severe performance degradation when parallel decoding is pushed too aggressively. We introduce Temporal Self-Distillation (TSD), a simple on-policy method that trains dLLMs for fast inference by distilling predictions across time. Specifically, TSD distills the model's denoising distribution at earlier timesteps toward its distribution at the final timestep at which a token is committed. This encourages earlier predictions to better anticipate the model's eventual output, enabling much more aggressive parallel decoding. Because its teacher signal comes from the model itself, TSD requires no offline teacher generation and applies seamlessly to both base and post-trained policies. Across seven benchmarks in mathematics, planning, and code, TSD substantially shifts the speed--quality frontier toward the low-compute regime. TSD thus

translated_title: 时序自蒸馏：离散扩散语言模型的更快推理
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型通过并行生成多个 token 来实现快速推理，但当并行解码过于激进时，其性能会严重下降。我们提出了时序自蒸馏，这是一种简单的在策略方法，通过跨时间步蒸馏预测来训练扩散语言模型以实现快速推理。具体而言，TSD 将模型在较早时间步的去噪分布蒸馏向其在最终提交 token 时间步的分布。这促使较早的预测能够更好地预判模型的最终输出，从而实现更加激进的并行解码。由于其教师信号来自模型自身，TSD 无需离线教师模型生成数据，并可以无缝应用于基础模型和经过后训练的策略。在数学、规划和代码领域的七个基准测试中，TSD 显著地将速度-质量前沿推向了低计算量区间。TSD 由此……
tldr: TSD 提出了一种时序自蒸馏方法，通过让模型早期时间步的预测向其最终提交 token 时的分布对齐，使扩散语言模型能够更激进地并行解码，无需离线教师模型即可显著提升低计算量下的推理速度与质量平衡。
en_tdlr: Temporal Self-Distillation (TSD) aligns a dLLM's earlier-timestep predictions with its final committed-token distribution, enabling much more aggressive parallel decoding and substantially shifting the speed-quality frontier toward the low-compute regime without any offline teacher.
